source_caption:
🎬 Avengement (2019) — Action, Crime, Thriller
Cain Burgess is a hardened man who has spent years in prison after being betrayed by the people he once trusted. When he finally escapes, he has only one thing on his mind: finding the people responsible for ruining his life and making them pay for what they did.
With nothing left to lose, Cain returns to the criminal underworld and confronts the people connected to his past. Every encounter reveals more about the betrayal that sent him to prison, while Cain uses his fighting skills and relentless determination to survive against anyone standing in his way.
But beneath all the violence is a story about pain, betrayal, and the consequences of revenge. Cain has been shaped by years of suffering, and his actions raise an important question: when someone has been pushed too far, can revenge ever give them the peace they are looking for?
More than just a brutal action movie, Avengement is about a man consumed by his past and determined to settle a score, even if it costs him everything. 🔥
💬 If you were betrayed and lost everything because of someone else, would you choose revenge or walk away? 👇

source_details.title: Avengement
source_details.synopsis: Avengement is a 2019 British action thriller film directed by Jesse V. Johnson who co-wrote the film with Stu Small. The film stars Scott Adkins, Craig Fairbrass and Thomas Turgoose. Avengement was released on 24 May 2019 on VOD and in selected theatres, where it received generally positive reviews from critics with praise for its action choreography and Adkins' performance. In 2020, a special edition was released, which contains an uncut version of the film.
